fb_text:
Tuesday, 7:52 AM. Your tech pulls up to a commercial property and the gate's locked.

The old way: he calls you. You're in the middle of your own stop, digging through a text thread from March trying to find the gate code.

The new way: he texts the bot. FieldNotes answers with the gate code in seconds — pulled from your own client list. Your phone never rang.

That's the whole product. Your crew texts like they already do. FieldNotes logs every stop and answers the questions that used to blow up your morning.

I run a commercial plant service company — 50+ corporate and commercial properties in the Metro Atlanta area. Gate codes, access notes, client quirks: it all lives in FieldNotes now, not in my head.

Try the 60-second demo: fieldnotesapp.io/app/try.html
